name: douyin_ecommerce-mcp
display_name: Douyin E-commerce — 抖店 (Doudian) seller + 精选联盟 / 巨量百应 + Doudian Open Platform MCP
description: Douyin E-commerce — 抖店 (Doudian) seller + 精选联盟 / 巨量百应 + Doudian Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers):

platform_mcp_douyin_ecommerce_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOUYIN_ECOMMERCE_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_douyin_ecommerce_app_key.description: Your Doudian app's app_key (抖店开放平台 → 应用管理).

platform_mcp_douyin_ecommerce_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOUYIN_ECOMMERCE_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_douyin_ecommerce_app_secret.description: The app's app_secret; it signs every call (hmac-sha256).

platform_mcp_douyin_ecommerce_access_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOUYIN_ECOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_douyin_ecommerce_access_tok.description: Shop access_token from /token/create (self-built apps: grant_type authorization_self with your shop_id). It lasts about 7 days; renew it with /token/refresh and update this value — the server does not renew it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: product.listV2 with one product: verifies app_key, signature and the shop access_token.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: product.listV2 (seller side: your own shop's products), page from 1, size up to 100. status 0 = online, 1 = offline; check_status 3 = approved. Prices are per SKU (see get_product). `query`/`category` are not applied. product_id values exceed 2^53: the Python server returns them exactly, the TypeScript server may round them — use get_product's product_id_str.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: product.detail by product_id: title, images, price (discount_price, in fen: 1990 = ¥19.90), status and spec_prices (SKU prices and stock).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: order.orderDetail by shop_order_id: status (order_status_desc), pay_amount in fen, create_time (unix seconds), logistics and SKU lines; buyer data is encrypted by the platform.

tools.name: track
tools.description: order.orderDetail logistics_info: the parcels (tracking_no, company_name, ship_time) of the order; route events are only available for Douyin e-waybills (logistics.trackNoRouteDetail).
